title: StampFly propeller shape data / StampFly プロペラの形状データ
provenance_ja: このデータは、開発者が公開リポジトリ prop_sim で行った写真からの実測(真上からの写真で平面形、切断面の写真で翼断面)を、2026-11-23 に写したものである。以後、プロペラの形状の基準はこのリポジトリのデータとし、測り直した場合はここを更新する。prop_sim は出どころである。区分(kind)は photo_measurement=写真の実測、nominal=型番の公称値、assumption=仮定、developer_measurement_20261123=開発者の実物の測定、repository_data=このリポジトリの他のデータ、estimate=見積もり。status が unconfirmed の項目は未確定。
provenance_en: This data was copied on 2026-11-23 from the developer's own photographic measurements in the public repository prop_sim (planform from a top-view photograph, section from a cut-section photograph). From now on this repository's data is the reference for the propeller shape; update it here when re-measured. prop_sim is the origin. kind: photo_measurement, nominal, assumption, developer_measurement_20261123, repository_data, estimate. Items with status 'unconfirmed' are not settled.

prop_sim.license: Copied under this repository's license (MIT), confirmed by the developer (2026-11-23); the data and photographs are the repository developer's own.

units: mm and degrees unless an item says otherwise

diameter_mm.source: prop_sim docs/STAMPFLY_1209.md section 1 and presets.py STAMPFLY_1209_MEASURED['diameter_mm']; top-view photo IMG_3578, scale 77.0 px/mm from a metal ruler; 99.5th percentile of the outline radius x 2; uncertainty +-0.2 mm

diameter_check_mm.source: developer's caliper-level measurement of the real propeller, 2026-11-23 (agrees with the photo value within the uncertainty)

blade_count.source: prop_sim STAMPFLY_1209_MEASURED['n_blades']; connected components of the photo

hub_diameter_mm.source: prop_sim STAMPFLY_1209_MEASURED['hub_outer_diameter_mm']; 2 x the radius where the azimuth coverage falls below 93 %

chord_table_r_over_R_mm.source: prop_sim presets.py _STAMPFLY_1209_CHORD (17 rows, all copied). Top-view width: arc length per radius x cos(sweep)
chord_table_r_over_R_mm.note: Not the true chord length; the builder converts it (see chord interpretation in README).

sweep_table_r_over_R_deg.source: prop_sim presets.py STAMPFLY_1209_SWEEP_DEG (8 rows, all copied). Angle between the blade centre line tangent and the radial direction

sweep_root_deg.source: constant inside r/R = 0.32 (the first table row); prop_sim has no data there

section_table_x_camber_thickness.source: prop_sim presets.py _STAMPFLY_1209_SECTION (24 rows, all copied). Cut-section photo IMG_3720, section painted black, extracted by gray<95 and saturation<70; chord = farthest point pair; smoothed by polynomials; no correction of the projection error
section_table_x_camber_thickness.note: One section only. Using it at every radius is an assumption (see section_same_at_all_radii).

section_same_at_all_radii.source: prop_sim uses this one section at all radii; only one cut was photographed

pitch_inch.source: nominal pitch of the type '1209' (prop_sim presets.stampfly_1209 pitch_in=0.9); the pitch cannot be read from a photograph. +-0.1 inch changes the hover speed by about 4 % (prop_sim docs section 10)
pitch_inch.note: Not confirmed on the real propeller. A separate CFD study found the nominal pitch closest to the bench data, but it is not settled.

pitch_offset_deg.source: uniform offset added to the twist angle; 0 = nominal pitch. prop_sim docs section 8 mentions a -7.8 deg equivalent to match one thrust point (not applied)

twist_formula.value: beta = atan(P / (2 pi r)) (constant geometric pitch), capped at twist_cap_deg

twist_cap_deg.source: prop_sim presets.stampfly_1209 np.deg2rad(48.0) upper limit of the twist angle

twist_pivot_chord_fraction.source: chord position of the twist axis; prop_sim models local blade elements and has no axis

hub_height_mm.source: prop_sim mass estimate used a hub thickness of 2.0 mm without a recorded origin; here the hub is a cylinder of this height
hub_height_mm.note: The real hub shape is not confirmed.

hub_hole_radius_mm.source: centre hole; the motor shaft radius is 0.4 mm (developer, 2026-11-23)

root_overlap_mm.source: blade root starts this far inside the hub radius so that the shells overlap

blade_plate_thickness_mm.source: prop_sim mass estimate input; equals 5.86 mm x 0.095 (max chord x max t/c), origin not recorded. The built blade thickness comes from the section instead

density_g_per_cm3.source: polycarbonate density used by prop_sim for its mass estimate

section_summary.source: prop_sim STAMPFLY_1209_MEASURED section_* entries (alpha0 from thin-airfoil theory)

mass_g.source: developer's measurement of one propeller, 2026-11-23 (1.01 g for 4)

mass_estimate_prop_sim_g.source: prop_sim: area x thickness (blade 0.55 mm / hub 2.0 mm) x PC 1.20 g/cm3

polar_inertia_prop_sim_kgm2.source: prop_sim: 0.264 m R^2 with m = 0.26 g from the same mass distribution; how the factor 0.264 was obtained is not documented

bench_rotor_inertia_kgm2.source: control/models/stampfly_physical.yaml plant J (bench 2026-10-15; the rotor inertia including the propeller and the motor rotor)

guard_inner_diameter_mm.source: developer's measurement 2026-11-23 (cylindrical part of the guard, about 32 mm)

motor_shaft_length_mm.source: developer's measurement 2026-11-23; the shaft top is at Y = 6.814 mm in the body STL frame

tip_height_target_mm.source: developer's reading of the real propeller tip height in 3D-model coordinates (body STL frame, Y up), 2026-11-23

axis_height_mm.source: hub centre height in the body STL frame, chosen so that the blade tip centre is 6.575 mm = the middle of tip_height_target_mm

rotors.source: motor_*.stl shaft-top centres in simulator/shared/assets/meshes/parts; spin directions from the comment in simulator/sils/models/stampfly.xml (M1 FR ccw, M2 RR cw, M3 RL ccw, M4 FL cw, seen from above)

spin_definition.value: ccw = counter-clockwise seen from +Y (above); the leading edge faces the rotation direction; the convex (suction) side is +Y; thrust is +Y
spin_definition.source: prop_sim frames.py / rotor.py: spin=+1 is the right-hand rotation about +z_h (thrust axis); section.py: camber > 0 when the upper side is convex

blade_face_orientation.value: leading edge on the rotation side, convex face up
blade_face_orientation.source: taken from the sign conventions of prop_sim, not from the real propeller
blade_face_orientation.note: Whether the real blade is built this way has not been checked.

primary_sources.note_ja: 平面形と翼断面の値の一次資料は次の 2 枚の写真(prop_sim の docs/images から内容を変えずに写した。SHA-256 が元と一致することを確認済み)。左の写真は真上から撮った実機プロペラと検出した外形(緑)、右は読み取った翼弦長の分布。元の撮影画像(IMG_3578.jpeg、IMG_3720.jpeg)と読み取りのスクリプトは prop_sim に無く、このリポジトリにも無い。
primary_sources.note_en: The primary sources of the planform and section values are these two photographs (copied unchanged from prop_sim docs/images; SHA-256 equal to the originals). The original camera images (IMG_3578.jpeg, IMG_3720.jpeg) and the extraction script are not in prop_sim and not in this repository.

propeller_source_photos/stampfly_1209_pl.ja: 左: 真上からの写真(元は IMG_3578.jpeg、金属定規で 77.0 px/mm に校正)に検出した外形(緑)・直径 31.2 mm・羽根 4 枚。右: 半径ごとの翼弦長(青点=半径一定の円弧幅、橙=羽根軸に直交する弦長、黒線=採用した表)。直径・枚数・ハブ径・翼弦長・後退角・投影面積を読んだ。
propeller_source_photos/stampfly_1209_pl.en: Left: top-view photograph (original IMG_3578.jpeg, scale 77.0 px/mm from a metal ruler) with the detected outline (green), D = 31.2 mm, 4 blades. Right: chord distribution (blue dots = arc width at constant r, orange = chord normal to the blade axis, black = adopted table). Diameter, blade count, hub diameter, chord, sweep and projected area were read from it.

propeller_source_photos/stampfly_1209_se.ja: 切断面を黒く塗った写真(元は IMG_3720.jpeg)に、読み取った上面(青緑)・下面(赤)・弦(黄)・キャンバ線(白破線)を重ねた図と、前縁の拡大。左下は読み取った断面(最大キャンバ 7.1 % @0.50c、最大厚み 9.5 % @0.20c)。右下の揚力曲線は prop_sim の解析で、形状データではない。翼断面の表(24 点)を読んだ。写真のコード線の傾き(29.6 度)は撮影の向きで決まっただけで、ピッチではない。
propeller_source_photos/stampfly_1209_se.en: Photograph of the cut section painted black (original IMG_3720.jpeg) with the extracted upper surface (cyan), lower surface (red), chord (yellow) and camber line (white dashed), and a leading-edge zoom. Lower left: the extracted section (max camber 7.1 % at 0.50c, max thickness 9.5 % at 0.20c). The lift curve at lower right is a prop_sim analysis, not shape data. The 24-point section table was read from it. The chord-line tilt in the photograph (29.6 deg) only reflects the camera direction and is not the pitch.

primary_sources.not_available: original camera images, ruler readings, extraction script, intermediate data (none of them in prop_sim)
primary_sources.which_propeller_photographed: The spin direction (ccw or cw type) of the photographed propeller and whether the photograph is seen from above or below are not recorded; the ccw type here assumes a top view (blades lag clockwise outward, as in the photograph).
